premise.title: The Road the Map Refused to Admit
premise.logline: During a routine re-survey of Ashen Gate, Leyra finds that a century-sealed boundary is answering to a road the legal map insists does not exist, while a private field mark tied to her mentor suggests someone investigated the anomaly before her.
premise.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer preparing for an independent map-seal license in a guild where witnessed geography can become magically binding.
premise.immediate_objective: Establish exactly what Ashen Gate is doing before dusk and decide what she can responsibly report without turning an extraordinary discovery into an unsupported claim.
premise.inciting_event: Leyra's ward-compass and an exterior boundary stone both respond as though a route continues through Ashen Gate, even though the legal map records the passage as sealed.
premise.central_problem: Leyra must separate a genuine change in the boundary from misleading magical residue while pressure from Greyfen and the guild makes both silence and overstatement consequential.
premise.wonder_or_discovery: The sealed arch appears to recognize a line that current maps deny, and an old private survey mark associated with Master Ilyan may be present near the gate without explaining what he knew or why he left it.
premise.stakes: A false reopening claim could make travelers trust an unstable magical road and end Leyra's apprenticeship; ignoring a real boundary change could leave Greyfen relying on a map that no longer describes the world.
constraints: Leyra may survey the exterior markers but may not cross the sealed boundary without authorization.
A private field mark can establish prior presence or survey activity but cannot prove motive, cause or a hidden conspiracy.
One session cannot prove why the road returned, what lies in the Nameless Vale, or whether other sealed roads are changing.
Any durable map claim must distinguish witnessed response from theory.
premise.meaningful_choice_pressure: Before the useful light and ward-response window fades, Leyra must choose how much time to spend trying to reproduce the gate response versus preserving a bounded report and confronting the fact that her mentor may have marked this place before.
premise.mystery_or_forward_question: Why is Ashen Gate answering to a road erased from legal maps, and what did Master Ilyan actually witness here years ago?
premise.local_payoff: The episode must resolve what Leyra can honestly put on record now. It may establish one bounded Ashen Gate anomaly, but must leave cause, wider scope, the Nameless Vale and Master Ilyan's motives unresolved unless evidence explicitly earns more.
persistent_outcomes_possible: forbidden_passage_observed becomes eligible if Leyra produces a dated bounded field record of the gate response
Greyfen gains a concrete but carefully worded reason to monitor the old boundary
Leyra's professional trust with Master Ilyan may shift based on how she handles incomplete evidence
an authorized follow-up survey may become possible without the passage being declared safe or reopened
world_specific_elements: ward-compasses that answer only to witnessed boundary lines
maps whose sealed claims can stabilize real roads and borders
private cartographer field marks that are informative but not legal proof

dimensions.name: PREMISE_MATURITY
dimensions.description: Core conflict should match the target reader's autonomy and conceptual range rather than relying on vocabulary to imply maturity.

dimensions.name: NARRATIVE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support layered goals, changing information, reversals, parallel pressures, and earned resolution.

dimensions.name: CONCEPTUAL_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Allow systems, institutions, evidence, ethics, ambiguity, identity, responsibility, and competing explanations at the target level.

dimensions.name: CAUSAL_DEPTH
dimensions.description: Important outcomes should arise from several linked causes, decisions, constraints, and consequences.

dimensions.name: INFERENCE_DEMAND
dimensions.description: Allow meaningful unstated connections and interpretation without making essential causality opaque.

dimensions.name: AGENCY_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: The protagonist should make consequential strategic choices among credible alternatives.

dimensions.name: STAKES_CONSEQUENCE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Stakes may affect reputation, relationships, livelihood, access, identity, institutions, safety, or world state without becoming melodramatic by default.

dimensions.name: SOCIAL_RELATIONSHIP_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support mixed motives, power differences, trust, conflict, loyalty, negotiation, and changing relationships without flattening people into roles.

dimensions.name: PREDICTABILITY_CHALLENGE
dimensions.description: Avoid obvious one-beat solutions; permit wrong models, reversals, incomplete information, and trade-offs.

dimensions.name: WONDER_DISCOVERY
dimensions.description: Adventure-oriented stories should still offer discovery, exploration, systems, mystery, or experiences larger than routine simulation.

dimensions.name: LANGUAGE_READABILITY
dimensions.description: Use clear, natural language appropriate to an independent adult reader; complexity should come from thought and structure, not unnecessary opacity.

required_story_capabilities: A protagonist with a credible age-appropriate role and independent agency
At least one layered objective, unresolved question, or competing priority
Multi-step causality with consequences that accumulate across the episode
A meaningful change in understanding rather than simple clue collection
A consequential choice, strategic trade-off, or irreversible local action
A local episode payoff that does not prematurely close long-horizon questions
Persistent consequence or reusable world-state value when earned
Adventure-oriented modes should include genuine discovery, exploration, mystery, or systems engagement
reject_signals: A premise made to feel older mainly through harder vocabulary
One obvious attempt solves the central problem without meaningful complication
The protagonist mostly observes while another character resolves the core problem
Exposition or lore substitutes for scene-level causality and choice
Mystery or conflict resolves by coincidence, withheld information, or unearned revelation
Violence, trauma, romance, cynicism, or darkness is added merely to signal maturity
The world could be replaced by a generic setting without materially changing the problem
language_rules: Prefer precise natural language over ornamental density
Domain-specific terminology is allowed when it serves action, reasoning, profession, or world logic and remains understandable in context
Do not use vocabulary difficulty as a substitute for premise or conceptual maturity
Let dialogue, action, evidence, and consequence carry interpretation where practical
Avoid juvenile narration unless the exact character voice or scene intentionally calls for it
safety_rules: Maturity does not require graphic violence, sexual content, trauma, or despair
Tension, danger, loss, rivalry, moral uncertainty, and difficult relationships may appear when relevant and proportionate
Do not force age stereotypes, illness, frailty, parenthood, nostalgia, or romance merely because the reader is older
calibration_notes: Age-18 stories may use adult-scale autonomy, institutions, ethical tension, identity, work/study responsibility, and ambiguous motives without assuming adult life experience.
Do not make the story feel adult merely by adding darker content or denser vocabulary.
Product session length remains separately governed by the cross-age qualification matrix.
Cross-age qualification authority: STANDARD product session is fixed at 1,600–2,500 words for the first controlled 12/18/25/40/60 proof so maturity is isolated from length.

character.name: Leyra
character.archetype: junior boundary cartographer and ward-map apprentice
traits: protective of people who trust maps
character.origin_summary: Leyra grew up in Greyfen watching adults trust boundary maps they could not read. At eighteen she is a junior ward-map apprentice at Vellum Hall, close to earning the right to seal independent surveys.
character.current_role: junior boundary cartographer under independent map-seal review

identity_anchors.statement: Leyra believes a map should never claim more than its maker can honestly witness.
Leyra is drawn to impossible places but refuses to call mystery proof.

core_drives.drive: Earn the right to chart places current maps cannot explain.
Keep border communities from paying the price for elegant but wrong maps.

internal_tensions.side_b: powerful desire to cross into the unknown
internal_tensions.description: Leyra's best discoveries tempt her to move faster than the rules that make those discoveries trustworthy.

immediate_desires: prove that wonder and discipline can coexist in serious cartography
immediate_avoidances: inventing certainty because a discovery feels important
being dismissed as a reckless village-born apprentice

world.era: late guild age in a kingdom whose borders are maintained by enchanted survey networks
world.habitat: forested border marches divided by old roads, warded valleys, ruined watch-lines and map-bound settlements
world.technology_level: ink presses, compasses, chain measures, glass lenses, horse travel and guild archives
world.magic_level: strong but rule-bound cartographic magic: witnessed boundaries can be sealed into maps, wardstones answer only to measured lines, and unverified geography cannot safely be written as fact
world.summary: The Veiled Marches are held together by maps that do more than describe roads and borders: once properly witnessed and sealed, they help stabilize them. Old routes sometimes disappear behind ward-lines, and the guild treats sealed passages as dangerous until independently re-surveyed. The magic rewards observation, corroboration and exact wording; a confident false map can be more dangerous than an incomplete one.
social_context: licensed cartographers carry both practical and magical authority
border villages depend on guild maps but bear the consequences when maps are wrong
crossing a sealed boundary without a survey warrant can end an apprenticeship
senior cartographers may maintain private field marks, but those marks are not legal evidence by themselves
old folktales about roads returning are common and usually dismissed as exaggeration
known_pressures: several outer wardstones have become harder to reconcile with legal maps
spring caravans will soon increase traffic through the border marches
Greyfen wants certainty before moving livestock near the old boundary
the guild fears panic caused by unverified claims about forgotten roads
known_world_facts: Leyra is an eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer based at Vellum Hall.
Ashen Gate is legally recorded as sealed and has not been formally reopened.
Greyfen lies beside the eastern ward-line and depends on stable boundary maps.
A legal map-seal requires witnessed survey evidence; private marks and rumors are not enough.
Crossing a sealed boundary without authorization can end an apprenticeship.
Master Ilyan trained Leyra and has never given her a clear account of his earlier Ashen Gate work.
No accepted evidence currently proves why old roads sometimes appear to return.

main_saga_public.title: The Unwritten Border
main_saga_public.goal: Discover why Ashen Gate and other retired boundary lines can begin answering to roads that legal maps say no longer exist.
main_saga_public.stakes: Wrongly restoring a dangerous road could expose border communities to unstable magic, while wrongly suppressing a real route could leave the guild blind to a changing world.
main_saga_public.central_mystery: The old boundary network is changing state according to rules the current guild only partly understands.

eligible_main_saga_milestones.summary: Leyra documents a repeatable visible or magical response showing that Ashen Gate currently answers to a path the legal map marks as sealed.
eligible_main_saga_milestones.state_condition: A dated field record establishes one bounded anomaly at Ashen Gate, without proving why the gate changed.
consequence_options: The guild must decide whether a formal re-survey is warranted.
Greyfen gains a concrete reason to watch the old boundary.

eligible_main_saga_milestones.summary: Leyra notices an old private field mark associated with Master Ilyan near the exterior survey stones.
eligible_main_saga_milestones.state_condition: The mark establishes only that Ilyan surveyed or marked this site before; it does not establish why or what he knew.
consequence_options: Leyra's trust question becomes more immediate.

eligible_main_saga_milestones.summary: A second survey condition confirms the gate response is not a single accidental compass twitch.
eligible_main_saga_milestones.state_condition: Leyra has corroborating field evidence that the boundary response is real, while cause remains unresolved.
consequence_options: Master Ilyan can no longer dismiss the event as one bad reading.

creation_constraints: Magic must follow rule-bound cartographic and boundary logic.
New durable facts must not explain why Ashen Gate reopened before the relevant reveal becomes eligible.
New NPCs should have plausible links to guild or border life.
forbidden_creations: Arbitrary spellcasting that bypasses surveying and evidence
Early confirmation of the Nameless Vale's purpose
Predetermined proof that Master Ilyan acted maliciously

architect_raw_payload.title: The Road the Map Refused to Admit
architect_raw_payload.story_promise: A junior cartographer finds a sealed gate answering to an erased road. She must decide what honest evidence she can leave on record, using only exterior surveying, before light and the Greyfen deadline run out.
architect_raw_payload.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer preparing for an independent map-seal license in a guild where witnessed geography can become magically binding.
architect_raw_payload.immediate_objective: Establish exactly what Ashen Gate is doing before dusk and decide what she can responsibly report without turning an extraordinary discovery into an unsupported claim.
architect_raw_payload.central_question: Is Ashen Gate really answering to a road the legal map denies, and how much of that can Leyra honestly put on record without overstating it?
architect_raw_payload.stakes: A false reopening claim could make travelers trust an unstable magical road and end Leyra's apprenticeship. Ignoring a real boundary change could leave Greyfen relying on a map that no longer describes the world.
constraints: Leyra may survey exterior markers only and never crosses the sealed boundary.
Master Ilyan's private field mark shows prior presence or survey activity only. It does not show motive, cause or conspiracy.
One session cannot establish why the road returned, what lies in the Nameless Vale, or whether other sealed roads are changing.
Any durable map claim must separate witnessed response from theory.
Ilyan is away at a chapter assembly and cannot be reached during the field day. He returns to Vellum Hall after dark, so mentor review happens only there.
The Nameless Vale is foreshadow-only and the Archive of Cinders is not used.
architect_raw_payload.opening_hook: In the Vellum Hall survey room, Leyra's ward-compass, set against the archived legal map for a routine re-survey, leans steadily toward a stretch of Ashen Gate's boundary that the map shows as blank, sealed wall. The senior clerk's warrant covers exterior survey only, and Ilyan is away until night.

logistics_plan.time_window: One day. Leave Vellum Hall mid-morning, reach Greyfen by late morning, reach Ashen Gate by early afternoon. The usable light and ward-response window runs to roughly late afternoon. The agreed departure from the gate is late afternoon. Return to Greyfen by dusk and to Vellum Hall after dark, shortly after Ilyan returns.
movement_constraints: Vellum Hall to Greyfen is about two hours by horse. Greyfen to Ashen Gate is about one hour on the old border track.
Leyra rides out with a Greyfen messenger, who acts as a physical witness at the exterior marker line and as the only communication path to Greyfen.

The messenger has agreed to leave the gate at the departure hour so Greyfen has an answer before it decides on its dawn livestock move. No remote messaging exists. Information travels only with the two riders.
Ilyan is at a chapter assembly and cannot be contacted or present at Ashen Gate. His review of the log happens only after both riders return to Vellum Hall.
Leyra does not cross the sealed boundary at any point.
logistics_plan.feasibility_rationale: The outbound ride totals about three hours and leaves a working window at the gate before the departure hour. The climax is a solo exterior survey task with the messenger already present as witness. Return legs fit before dusk and nightfall, so Greyfen receives the branch result before its dawn decision. Ilyan's review is placed after the return, so no instant mentor presence is needed.

beats.purpose: Open at Vellum Hall with a concrete map and ward anomaly that sets the task and the limits.
beats.character_action: Leyra calibrates her ward-compass against the archived legal map. She notes a steady lean toward a blank, sealed segment of Ashen Gate and logs it as a bench reading only. She asks the clerk for exterior survey authority and a steady control stone to compare against.
beats.external_event: The compass leans at the same bearing across three recalibrations. The senior clerk grants an exterior-only warrant and says Ilyan is at a chapter assembly until after dark.
beats.new_information: The compass response was seen at the hall and is not yet tied to the gate itself. Ilyan is unreachable during the day. The warrant forbids crossing.
beats.escalation_delta: A routine task becomes a bounded field investigation under written limits.
beats.state_change: Leyra holds an exterior-only warrant and a bench reading, and she has no mentor to consult.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets the evidentiary standard and the no-crossing line.

beats.purpose: Establish Greyfen's pressure, the witness, and the communication path before the field work.
beats.character_action: Leyra stops in Greyfen. She tells the reeve only that she is re-surveying and promises an honest answer, not a favorable one. She accepts the messenger Dessa as a witness to ride with her.
beats.external_event: The reeve explains that Greyfen will decide at dawn whether to move livestock near the old boundary. Dessa will ride out and return with whatever Leyra can say by the departure hour.
beats.new_information: Greyfen's decision depends on her answer. Dessa can witness readings but cannot judge them. The departure hour is fixed by Greyfen's need to decide before dawn.
beats.escalation_delta: A community now depends on the outcome, and silence or overstatement both have a cost.
beats.state_change: Leyra has a witness, a hard departure time and a defined audience for her result.
beats.payoff_contribution: Makes the Greyfen effects of each branch concrete and feasible.

beats.purpose: Deliver the wonder and the first observation at the gate.
beats.character_action: Leyra walks the exterior markers with the compass. At the outer boundary stone she records bearings and times. Dessa watches from the marker line.
beats.external_event: Both the compass and the outer boundary stone respond as if a route continues through the sealed arch along the bearing the legal map denies. The response is strong at first. A steady control stone farther along the wall shows no response.
beats.new_information: The response is observable at the gate and at the stone, with a strong initial reading. The control stone is quiet. It does not yet show whether the response is fixed, variable or residue.
beats.escalation_delta: A bench curiosity becomes a witnessed field anomaly that contradicts the sealed record.
beats.state_change: Leyra has a first dated reading and a witness. She is tempted to call it a reopening.
beats.payoff_contribution: Supplies the core observation behind the bounded record.

beats.purpose: Add the mentor-secret thread without overreaching.
beats.character_action: While checking the stone's base for wear that could alter readings, Leyra finds a small private field mark on the underside of an exterior survey stone. She recognizes Ilyan's style and records it with a sketch and position, without touching the arch.
beats.external_event: The mark is weathered and sits partly under lichen, beside the line the compass follows.
beats.new_information: Ilyan, or someone using his mark style, surveyed or marked this site years ago. The mark gives no date, reason or finding. Ilyan never told her he worked at the gate.
beats.escalation_delta: The question moves from what the gate is doing to what her mentor did not tell her. She must not let that colour the record.
beats.state_change: Leyra has a personal stake and a rule she must keep: the mark proves presence only.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets up the later trust shift while leaving his motives unresolved.

beats.purpose: Test the first reading and shrink the decision space.
beats.character_action: Leyra clears and resets the compass, then repeats the measurement at the stone. She logs the time and light for each reading and checks the control stone again.
beats.external_event: The fresh reading is weaker than the first, then strengthens. The control stone stays steady. Light begins to slant and cool and the departure hour approaches.
beats.new_information: The response is not a single twitch, but it changes over time. Light, temperature, residue left by the first reading, or a ward-timing effect could each be driving the change. The reset reduces but does not remove the setup explanations.
beats.escalation_delta: A confirmed response now has an unexplained time pattern and a closing window. Further testing and reporting begin to compete for the same hour.
beats.state_change: Leyra has three timed readings and a steady control comparison. The window is shorter and the strategy has to change.
beats.payoff_contribution: Provides the evidence base the reversal rests on.

beats.purpose: Revise her working model only as far as the evidence allows.
beats.character_action: Leyra lays the three readings and the control reading side by side and rejects her working assumption that the gate shows a single fixed, static line. She writes what she observed apart from what she suspects.
beats.external_event: Dessa notes that the strong readings came while the light was higher. Leyra confirms this from her own time notes.
beats.new_information: The response changes over time while the control stone does not. This rules out only a fixed, unchanging response. Light, temperature, residue and ward-timing effects all remain possible and none has been tested.
beats.escalation_delta: The simple choice of fixed reopening versus mistake becomes a more complex model with untested causes, so a clean claim is no longer available.
beats.state_change: Leyra can state what she saw but not what it means. She must decide how to spend the remaining window.
beats.payoff_contribution: Gives the bounded record its honest limits.

beats.purpose: Make the choice that defines the branch.
beats.character_action: With the departure hour near, Leyra weighs trying to reproduce the response again against sealing a bounded record now. She also considers that Ilyan can only review it after she returns.
beats.external_event: Dessa reminds her of the departure hour and that Greyfen will decide without her if no one arrives.
beats.new_information: No new evidence arrives. The decision rests on what she has and what each option is likely to cost.
beats.escalation_delta: Time becomes the binding constraint, and each option closes the other.
beats.state_change: Leyra commits to one of two branches, and nothing is decided until this beat.
beats.payoff_contribution: Gives the climax its branch-specific structure.

beats.purpose: Resolve the choice using only the established evidence, resources and witness.
beats.character_action: Leyra executes the branch she chose. In both branches she works only at the exterior stone and marker line, with Dessa present, and does not cross the boundary.
beats.external_event: The light fades and the departure hour arrives. The branch result is fixed.
beats.new_information: Bounded branch: one last timed reading confirms the same pattern and completes the record. Extend branch: further trials produce inconsistent readings that cannot be written as a reliable record.
beats.escalation_delta: The time pressure ends in a concrete result: a witnessed record, or unverified notes.
beats.state_change: Leyra leaves with a signed bounded record or with labeled raw notes, as the branch determines.
beats.payoff_contribution: Delivers the branch-specific local payoff.

beats.purpose: Close the Greyfen thread with the branch-specific outcome.
beats.character_action: Leyra and Dessa ride back to Greyfen before dusk. Leyra gives the reeve the result her branch earned, with its limits stated plainly.
beats.external_event: The reeve weighs the answer against the dawn livestock move.
beats.new_information: Bounded branch: Greyfen receives the careful wording. Extend branch: Greyfen receives only an unverified sighting and no determination.
beats.escalation_delta: The consequence moves from the field to the community that depends on the map.
beats.state_change: Greyfen acts on what it was actually given, and the two branches differ.
beats.payoff_contribution: Provides the community-facing local closure.

beats.purpose: Close the mentor thread after the return without resolving his motive.
beats.character_action: Leyra returns to Vellum Hall after dark. Ilyan has just come back from the assembly. She presents her log and mentions the mark, separating the fact of it from any theory.
beats.external_event: Ilyan reviews what she brought and reacts according to its quality. He does not explain the mark.
beats.new_information: Ilyan acknowledges the mark is his only if asked directly and gives no reason. His reaction depends on the record she brought.
beats.escalation_delta: The mentor question becomes immediate and personal but stays unanswered.
beats.state_change: Leyra's trust in Ilyan shifts according to how she handled incomplete evidence.
beats.payoff_contribution: Closes the episode with a relationship change and an open forward question.

escalation_ladder: A compass lean at Vellum Hall becomes a committed field investigation under an exterior-only warrant.
Greyfen's dawn deadline makes the result consequential for a community.
The gate response is witnessed and contradicts the sealed record. The first reading invites overclaiming.
Ilyan's mark adds personal pressure without adding evidence of cause.
The reset shows a time-varying response and the light begins to fade, so reproducing the response competes with reporting.
Fading light and the fixed departure hour force a choice between extending testing and sealing a bounded record.

reversal.prior_belief: The gate's response is a single fixed, static line, so it is either a clean reopening signal or an artifact of one bad reading.

evidence.claim: The compass and the outer boundary stone both responded strongly at the first reading, and the control stone showed no response.
After a fresh reset, the response was weaker and then strengthened, while the control stone stayed steady.
Leyra's time and light notes show stronger readings in higher light. This is a correlation across a small number of readings.
Ilyan's private mark shows prior presence or survey activity near the line, and nothing more.
The variation may reflect light, temperature, residue or ward timing. None of these has been separately tested.

reversal.reinterpretation: The response is not a fixed, static line. It varies over time at the gate while a nearby control stone does not. This rejects only the static interpretation. Residual and light-linked magical effects remain fully possible, as do other confounds.
reversal.inference_ceiling: Leyra can claim a time-varying, witnessed response at the exterior stone and compass, consistent across a few readings, that differs from the control stone and from the sealed legal record. She cannot claim a cause, a recurrence beyond today, a reopening or a safe road.
reversal.unresolved_after_reversal: Why the response varies, whether light or residue drives it, whether it recurs on other days, what Ilyan saw or intended, what lies in the Nameless Vale, and whether other sealed roads are changing.

decision_point.pressure: The useful light and ward-response window is closing and the departure hour is fixed. Leyra must choose between spending the remaining time reproducing the response and sealing a bounded record now, while knowing Ilyan will see the result only after she returns.

branches.option: Complete one final timed reading, then write and witness a bounded field record.
branches.immediate_action: Leyra takes one last timed reading at the exterior stone and then writes the record. It lists each reading with time, light and control-stone result and separates witnessed response from theory. Dessa signs as witness and the record is dated.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: A dated, witnessed field record exists. It establishes one bounded anomaly at Ashen Gate. It states that cause, recurrence, wider scope, the Nameless Vale and Ilyan's motive are unknown. It records the mark as prior presence only.
branches.cost_or_risk: She gives up further attempts to reproduce the response. The record is deliberately modest, and she may be criticized for not testing light or temperature.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Greyfen receives careful wording. Ilyan reviews the log only after the return, at Vellum Hall, and challenges its weak points. Because the record separates fact from theory he cannot dismiss it as one bad reading, and his trust in her work rises. His silence about the mark strains her trust in him. An authorized follow-up survey becomes possible, but the passage is not declared safe or reopened.
branches.climax_requirement: At the exterior stone, with Dessa present and before the departure hour, Leyra completes the final reading and the witnessed record using only the readings already in her log. She does not cross the boundary and does not claim more than the reversal allows.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: Leyra leaves with a dated, witnessed, bounded record. It is eligible to support the forbidden_passage_observed milestone if committed. Greyfen has a concrete, carefully worded reason to monitor the old boundary. Ilyan reviews the record that night.

branches.option: Use the remaining window to try to reproduce the response and isolate the cause.
branches.immediate_action: Leyra runs further timed readings at the stone, varying her position and resets, and checks the control stone against each one. She keeps the raw notes. Dessa waits at the marker line until the departure hour.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: Leyra has more raw readings, but they are inconsistent as the light fades and none isolates a cause. No signed or witnessed bounded record exists. The notes are labeled unverified.
branches.cost_or_risk: She misses the window to seal a clean record and may leave with less than she had at the reversal. Greyfen gets no clear answer.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Dessa leaves with Leyra at the departure hour and carries only the message that an unverified response was seen and no determination exists. Greyfen must decide its dawn move without a clear answer and may delay or act cautiously on its own. Ilyan reviews only unverified raw notes at Vellum Hall after the return and tells her they do not support a record. This costs her some standing with him, though he credits her honesty in labeling them. No follow-up survey is authorized yet, though she may request one.
branches.climax_requirement: At the exterior stone, with Dessa present, Leyra runs her final trials until the departure hour and then honestly labels the results as unverified rather than forcing them into a record. She does not cross the boundary.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: Leyra leaves with honest, labeled raw notes and an accurate account of what is not yet known. There is no formal record, so the milestone stays ineligible. Greyfen is told only that an unverified response was seen.

decision_point.what_is_unknown: Whether the response recurs on another day, whether light or something else drives it, and what Ilyan found at this site.

architect_raw_payload.climax: At the exterior stone at the end of the window, with Dessa as witness, Leyra carries out the branch she chose. In seal_bounded_report she takes one last reading and writes a witnessed, bounded record that separates what she saw from what she suspects. In extend_testing she runs her final trials and labels the inconsistent results as unverified. In both, she uses only her earlier readings, the control stone, Dessa's presence and the exterior limits, and she does not cross the boundary.
architect_raw_payload.local_payoff: Leyra leaves Ashen Gate without crossing it and has reported only what her evidence supports, with witnessed fact kept apart from theory. Greyfen is given exactly what her branch earned and no more. Cause, recurrence, wider scope, the Nameless Vale and Ilyan's motive remain unresolved. In seal_bounded_report she holds a dated, witnessed bounded record. In extend_testing she holds only labeled unverified notes and no formal record.
architect_raw_payload.forward_hook: Ilyan's private mark sits beside the line the gate answers to, and he has not said why. Whether the response returns on another day is still unknown.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: A dated, witnessed, bounded field record of the time-varying gate response at Ashen Gate. It makes forbidden_passage_observed eligible.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only if delivered prose shows Leyra choosing seal_bounded_report and completing the witnessed record with the stated limits.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: An authorized follow-up exterior survey becomes possible without the passage being declared safe or reopened.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only if the bounded record is completed and Ilyan or the guild reviews it in prose.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: Greyfen gains a concrete, carefully worded reason to monitor the old boundary.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only in the seal_bounded_report branch, where the careful wording is delivered to the reeve.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: Leyra's professional trust with Master Ilyan shifts according to how she handled incomplete evidence and how he reacted when she raised the mark.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only if the prose shows the review at Vellum Hall and Ilyan's reaction.

episode_spine.title: The Road the Map Refused to Admit
episode_spine.story_promise: A junior cartographer finds a sealed gate answering to an erased road. She must decide what honest evidence she can leave on record, using only exterior surveying, before light and the Greyfen deadline run out.
episode_spine.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer preparing for an independent map-seal license in a guild where witnessed geography can become magically binding.
episode_spine.immediate_objective: Establish exactly what Ashen Gate is doing before dusk and decide what she can responsibly report without turning an extraordinary discovery into an unsupported claim.
episode_spine.central_question: Is Ashen Gate really answering to a road the legal map denies, and how much of that can Leyra honestly put on record without overstating it?
episode_spine.stakes: A false reopening claim could make travelers trust an unstable magical road and end Leyra's apprenticeship. Ignoring a real boundary change could leave Greyfen relying on a map that no longer describes the world.
constraints: Leyra may survey exterior markers only and never crosses the sealed boundary.
Master Ilyan's private field mark shows prior presence or survey activity only. It does not show motive, cause or conspiracy.
One session cannot establish why the road returned, what lies in the Nameless Vale, or whether other sealed roads are changing.
Any durable map claim must separate witnessed response from theory.
Ilyan is away at a chapter assembly and cannot be reached during the field day. He returns to Vellum Hall after dark, so mentor review happens only there.
The Nameless Vale is foreshadow-only and the Archive of Cinders is not used.
episode_spine.opening_hook: In the Vellum Hall survey room, Leyra's ward-compass, set against the archived legal map for a routine re-survey, leans steadily toward a stretch of Ashen Gate's boundary that the map shows as blank, sealed wall. The senior clerk's warrant covers exterior survey only, and Ilyan is away until night.

logistics_plan.time_window: One day. Leave Vellum Hall mid-morning, reach Greyfen by late morning, reach Ashen Gate by early afternoon. The usable light and ward-response window runs to roughly late afternoon. The agreed departure from the gate is late afternoon. Return to Greyfen by dusk and to Vellum Hall after dark, shortly after Ilyan returns.
movement_constraints: Vellum Hall to Greyfen is about two hours by horse. Greyfen to Ashen Gate is about one hour on the old border track.
Leyra rides out with a Greyfen messenger, who acts as a physical witness at the exterior marker line and as the only communication path to Greyfen.

The messenger has agreed to leave the gate at the departure hour so Greyfen has an answer before it decides on its dawn livestock move. No remote messaging exists. Information travels only with the two riders.
Ilyan is at a chapter assembly and cannot be contacted or present at Ashen Gate. His review of the log happens only after both riders return to Vellum Hall.
Leyra does not cross the sealed boundary at any point.
logistics_plan.feasibility_rationale: The outbound ride totals about three hours and leaves a working window at the gate before the departure hour. The climax is a solo exterior survey task with the messenger already present as witness. Return legs fit before dusk and nightfall, so Greyfen receives the branch result before its dawn decision. Ilyan's review is placed after the return, so no instant mentor presence is needed.

beats.purpose: Open at Vellum Hall with a concrete map and ward anomaly that sets the task and the limits.
beats.character_action: Leyra calibrates her ward-compass against the archived legal map. She notes a steady lean toward a blank, sealed segment of Ashen Gate and logs it as a bench reading only. She asks the clerk for exterior survey authority and a steady control stone to compare against.
beats.external_event: The compass leans at the same bearing across three recalibrations. The senior clerk grants an exterior-only warrant and says Ilyan is at a chapter assembly until after dark.
beats.new_information: The compass response was seen at the hall and is not yet tied to the gate itself. Ilyan is unreachable during the day. The warrant forbids crossing.
beats.escalation_delta: A routine task becomes a bounded field investigation under written limits.
beats.state_change: Leyra holds an exterior-only warrant and a bench reading, and she has no mentor to consult.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets the evidentiary standard and the no-crossing line.

beats.purpose: Establish Greyfen's pressure, the witness, and the communication path before the field work.
beats.character_action: Leyra stops in Greyfen. She tells the reeve only that she is re-surveying and promises an honest answer, not a favorable one. She accepts the messenger Dessa as a witness to ride with her.
beats.external_event: The reeve explains that Greyfen will decide at dawn whether to move livestock near the old boundary. Dessa will ride out and return with whatever Leyra can say by the departure hour.
beats.new_information: Greyfen's decision depends on her answer. Dessa can witness readings but cannot judge them. The departure hour is fixed by Greyfen's need to decide before dawn.
beats.escalation_delta: A community now depends on the outcome, and silence or overstatement both have a cost.
beats.state_change: Leyra has a witness, a hard departure time and a defined audience for her result.
beats.payoff_contribution: Makes the Greyfen effects of each branch concrete and feasible.

beats.purpose: Deliver the wonder and the first observation at the gate.
beats.character_action: Leyra walks the exterior markers with the compass. At the outer boundary stone she records bearings and times. Dessa watches from the marker line.
beats.external_event: Both the compass and the outer boundary stone respond as if a route continues through the sealed arch along the bearing the legal map denies. The response is strong at first. A steady control stone farther along the wall shows no response.
beats.new_information: The response is observable at the gate and at the stone, with a strong initial reading. The control stone is quiet. It does not yet show whether the response is fixed, variable or residue.
beats.escalation_delta: A bench curiosity becomes a witnessed field anomaly that contradicts the sealed record.
beats.state_change: Leyra has a first dated reading and a witness. She is tempted to call it a reopening.
beats.payoff_contribution: Supplies the core observation behind the bounded record.

beats.purpose: Add the mentor-secret thread without overreaching.
beats.character_action: While checking the stone's base for wear that could alter readings, Leyra finds a small private field mark on the underside of an exterior survey stone. She recognizes Ilyan's style and records it with a sketch and position, without touching the arch.
beats.external_event: The mark is weathered and sits partly under lichen, beside the line the compass follows.
beats.new_information: Ilyan, or someone using his mark style, surveyed or marked this site years ago. The mark gives no date, reason or finding. Ilyan never told her he worked at the gate.
beats.escalation_delta: The question moves from what the gate is doing to what her mentor did not tell her. She must not let that colour the record.
beats.state_change: Leyra has a personal stake and a rule she must keep: the mark proves presence only.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets up the later trust shift while leaving his motives unresolved.

beats.purpose: Test the first reading and shrink the decision space.
beats.character_action: Leyra clears and resets the compass, then repeats the measurement at the stone. She logs the time and light for each reading and checks the control stone again.
beats.external_event: The fresh reading is weaker than the first, then strengthens. The control stone stays steady. Light begins to slant and cool and the departure hour approaches.
beats.new_information: The response is not a single twitch, but it changes over time. Light, temperature, residue left by the first reading, or a ward-timing effect could each be driving the change. The reset reduces but does not remove the setup explanations.
beats.escalation_delta: A confirmed response now has an unexplained time pattern and a closing window. Further testing and reporting begin to compete for the same hour.
beats.state_change: Leyra has three timed readings and a steady control comparison. The window is shorter and the strategy has to change.
beats.payoff_contribution: Provides the evidence base the reversal rests on.

beats.purpose: Revise her working model only as far as the evidence allows.
beats.character_action: Leyra lays the three readings and the control reading side by side and rejects her working assumption that the gate shows a single fixed, static line. She writes what she observed apart from what she suspects.
beats.external_event: Dessa notes that the strong readings came while the light was higher. Leyra confirms this from her own time notes.
beats.new_information: The response changes over time while the control stone does not. This rules out only a fixed, unchanging response. Light, temperature, residue and ward-timing effects all remain possible and none has been tested.
beats.escalation_delta: The simple choice of fixed reopening versus mistake becomes a more complex model with untested causes, so a clean claim is no longer available.
beats.state_change: Leyra can state what she saw but not what it means. She must decide how to spend the remaining window.
beats.payoff_contribution: Gives the bounded record its honest limits.

beats.purpose: Make the choice that defines the branch.
beats.character_action: With the departure hour near, Leyra weighs trying to reproduce the response again against sealing a bounded record now. She also considers that Ilyan can only review it after she returns.
beats.external_event: Dessa reminds her of the departure hour and that Greyfen will decide without her if no one arrives.
beats.new_information: No new evidence arrives. The decision rests on what she has and what each option is likely to cost.
beats.escalation_delta: Time becomes the binding constraint, and each option closes the other.
beats.state_change: Leyra commits to one of two branches, and nothing is decided until this beat.
beats.payoff_contribution: Gives the climax its branch-specific structure.

beats.purpose: Resolve the choice using only the established evidence, resources and witness.
beats.character_action: Leyra executes the branch she chose. In both branches she works only at the exterior stone and marker line, with Dessa present, and does not cross the boundary.
beats.external_event: The light fades and the departure hour arrives. The branch result is fixed.
beats.new_information: Bounded branch: one last timed reading confirms the same pattern and completes the record. Extend branch: further trials produce inconsistent readings that cannot be written as a reliable record.
beats.escalation_delta: The time pressure ends in a concrete result: a witnessed record, or unverified notes.
beats.state_change: Leyra leaves with a signed bounded record or with labeled raw notes, as the branch determines.
beats.payoff_contribution: Delivers the branch-specific local payoff.

beats.purpose: Close the Greyfen thread with the branch-specific outcome.
beats.character_action: Leyra and Dessa ride back to Greyfen before dusk. Leyra gives the reeve the result her branch earned, with its limits stated plainly.
beats.external_event: The reeve weighs the answer against the dawn livestock move.
beats.new_information: Bounded branch: Greyfen receives the careful wording. Extend branch: Greyfen receives only an unverified sighting and no determination.
beats.escalation_delta: The consequence moves from the field to the community that depends on the map.
beats.state_change: Greyfen acts on what it was actually given, and the two branches differ.
beats.payoff_contribution: Provides the community-facing local closure.

beats.purpose: Close the mentor thread after the return without resolving his motive.
beats.character_action: Leyra returns to Vellum Hall after dark. Ilyan has just come back from the assembly. She presents her log and mentions the mark, separating the fact of it from any theory.
beats.external_event: Ilyan reviews what she brought and reacts according to its quality. He does not explain the mark.
beats.new_information: Ilyan acknowledges the mark is his only if asked directly and gives no reason. His reaction depends on the record she brought.
beats.escalation_delta: The mentor question becomes immediate and personal but stays unanswered.
beats.state_change: Leyra's trust in Ilyan shifts according to how she handled incomplete evidence.
beats.payoff_contribution: Closes the episode with a relationship change and an open forward question.

escalation_ladder: A compass lean at Vellum Hall becomes a committed field investigation under an exterior-only warrant.
Greyfen's dawn deadline makes the result consequential for a community.
The gate response is witnessed and contradicts the sealed record. The first reading invites overclaiming.
Ilyan's mark adds personal pressure without adding evidence of cause.
The reset shows a time-varying response and the light begins to fade, so reproducing the response competes with reporting.
Fading light and the fixed departure hour force a choice between extending testing and sealing a bounded record.

reversal.prior_belief: The gate's response is a single fixed, static line, so it is either a clean reopening signal or an artifact of one bad reading.

evidence.claim: The compass and the outer boundary stone both responded strongly at the first reading, and the control stone showed no response.
After a fresh reset, the response was weaker and then strengthened, while the control stone stayed steady.
Leyra's time and light notes show stronger readings in higher light. This is a correlation across a small number of readings.
Ilyan's private mark shows prior presence or survey activity near the line, and nothing more.
The variation may reflect light, temperature, residue or ward timing. None of these has been separately tested.

reversal.reinterpretation: The response is not a fixed, static line. It varies over time at the gate while a nearby control stone does not. This rejects only the static interpretation. Residual and light-linked magical effects remain fully possible, as do other confounds.
reversal.inference_ceiling: Leyra can claim a time-varying, witnessed response at the exterior stone and compass, consistent across a few readings, that differs from the control stone and from the sealed legal record. She cannot claim a cause, a recurrence beyond today, a reopening or a safe road.
reversal.unresolved_after_reversal: Why the response varies, whether light or residue drives it, whether it recurs on other days, what Ilyan saw or intended, what lies in the Nameless Vale, and whether other sealed roads are changing.

decision_point.pressure: The useful light and ward-response window is closing and the departure hour is fixed. Leyra must choose between spending the remaining time reproducing the response and sealing a bounded record now, while knowing Ilyan will see the result only after she returns.

branches.option: Complete one final timed reading, then write and witness a bounded field record.
branches.immediate_action: Leyra takes one last timed reading at the exterior stone and then writes the record. It lists each reading with time, light and control-stone result and separates witnessed response from theory. Dessa signs as witness and the record is dated.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: A dated, witnessed field record exists. It establishes one bounded anomaly at Ashen Gate. It states that cause, recurrence, wider scope, the Nameless Vale and Ilyan's motive are unknown. It records the mark as prior presence only.
branches.cost_or_risk: She gives up further attempts to reproduce the response. The record is deliberately modest, and she may be criticized for not testing light or temperature.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Greyfen receives careful wording. Ilyan reviews the log only after the return, at Vellum Hall, and challenges its weak points. Because the record separates fact from theory he cannot dismiss it as one bad reading, and his trust in her work rises. His silence about the mark strains her trust in him. An authorized follow-up survey becomes possible, but the passage is not declared safe or reopened.
branches.climax_requirement: At the exterior stone, with Dessa present and before the departure hour, Leyra completes the final reading and the witnessed record using only the readings already in her log. She does not cross the boundary and does not claim more than the reversal allows.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: Leyra leaves with a dated, witnessed, bounded record. It is eligible to support the forbidden_passage_observed milestone if committed. Greyfen has a concrete, carefully worded reason to monitor the old boundary. Ilyan reviews the record that night.

branches.option: Use the remaining window to try to reproduce the response and isolate the cause.
branches.immediate_action: Leyra runs further timed readings at the stone, varying her position and resets, and checks the control stone against each one. She keeps the raw notes. Dessa waits at the marker line until the departure hour.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: Leyra has more raw readings, but they are inconsistent as the light fades and none isolates a cause. No signed or witnessed bounded record exists. The notes are labeled unverified.
branches.cost_or_risk: She misses the window to seal a clean record and may leave with less than she had at the reversal. Greyfen gets no clear answer.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Dessa leaves with Leyra at the departure hour and carries only the message that an unverified response was seen and no determination exists. Greyfen must decide its dawn move without a clear answer and may delay or act cautiously on its own. Ilyan reviews only unverified raw notes at Vellum Hall after the return and tells her they do not support a record. This costs her some standing with him, though he credits her honesty in labeling them. No follow-up survey is authorized yet, though she may request one.
branches.climax_requirement: At the exterior stone, with Dessa present, Leyra runs her final trials until the departure hour and then honestly labels the results as unverified rather than forcing them into a record. She does not cross the boundary.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: Leyra leaves with honest, labeled raw notes and an accurate account of what is not yet known. There is no formal record, so the milestone stays ineligible. Greyfen is told only that an unverified response was seen.

decision_point.what_is_unknown: Whether the response recurs on another day, whether light or something else drives it, and what Ilyan found at this site.

episode_spine.climax: At the exterior stone at the end of the window, with Dessa as witness, Leyra carries out the branch she chose. In seal_bounded_report she takes one last reading and writes a witnessed, bounded record that separates what she saw from what she suspects. In extend_testing she runs her final trials and labels the inconsistent results as unverified. In both, she uses only her earlier readings, the control stone, Dessa's presence and the exterior limits, and she does not cross the boundary.
episode_spine.local_payoff: Leyra leaves Ashen Gate without crossing it and has reported only what her evidence supports, with witnessed fact kept apart from theory. Greyfen is given exactly what her branch earned and no more. Cause, recurrence, wider scope, the Nameless Vale and Ilyan's motive remain unresolved. In seal_bounded_report she holds a dated, witnessed bounded record. In extend_testing she holds only labeled unverified notes and no formal record.
episode_spine.forward_hook: Ilyan's private mark sits beside the line the gate answers to, and he has not said why. Whether the response returns on another day is still unknown.
